verdict.rationale: Circle is a developer platform with automation-adjacent features, such as CCTP destination-chain actions, agent wallets with spending policies, and webhooks, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. Idempotency keys and spending policies are adjacent controls, not version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
